column3: Customers may return unused items within 30 days of delivery. Products must have original packaging and tags.
Approved refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.
Standard shipping usually takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping usually takes 1 to 2 business days.
Customers can track orders using the tracking number provided in the shipping confirmation email.
Orders can be cancelled before shipment. Once shipped, customers must follow the return policy.
Customers who receive damaged products should contact support within 48 hours and provide photographs.
